title: ROBOVIEW-BIAS: BENCHMARKING VISUAL BIAS IN EMBODIED AGENTS FOR ROBOTIC MANIPULATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success rates of embodied agents in simulated robotic manipulation tasks across 141 different object colors to quantify performance variations and preferences for salient, high-saturation colors over achromatic or low-saturation ones.

Measuring fluctuations in agent task success rates (using a defined Bias Coefficient) when subjected to various camera orientations, including minor Euler angle perturbations and multiple circular overhead orbit positions.
Translating the camera backward along the line-of-sight direction to discrete distance levels to assess how scale changes impact the embodied agent's performance stability.
